entities.name: Thurzen Klathe
entities.description: Lord High Priest of the Order of the Ebon Hand on Sarpadia, residing in Achtep Keep; addressed as His Excellency.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: A cruel Sarpadian order practicing horrific sacrifices.

entities.name: Sarya Haasendel
entities.description: Leader of the dwarves who received aid from Klathe.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: A mercenary Klathe sent to the dwarves, who joined the orcs.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: The continent where the Ebon Hand holds power.

events.summary: When the dwarves are attacked by orcs and goblins, Klathe alone among Sarpadian leaders sends aid to Sarya Haasendel, seeing a chance for conversion.
events.quote: Klathe was the only leader of the other four Sarpadian nations to send aid

events.summary: Klathe sends the mercenary Ivra Jursdotter, who joins the orcs, sealing the dwarves' fate.
events.quote: he sent the mercenary Ivra Jursdotter

relations.note: Lord High Priest of the Order.
relations.quote: Lord High Priest of the Order of the Ebon Hand

relations.note: Sent by Klathe as a mercenary.
relations.quote: he sent the mercenary Ivra Jursdotter
